remarks:
Welcome to Wade Hill Road in Ellington, New York, offering approximately 13 acres of beautiful, wooded land across two separate parcels (Tax Map Nos. 288.00-2-40.1 and 288.00-2-33.1). Whether you're looking to build your dream home, create a private getaway, or invest in recreational property, this versatile offering provides endless possibilities.

Surrounded by nature, the property features mature woods that provide privacy, scenic beauty, and abundant wildlife. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the excellent opportunities for hunting, camping, hiking, ATV riding, or simply enjoying the peaceful country setting.

With approximately 13 acres spread across two parcels(9.5 & 3.7), you'll have the flexibility to build a custom home or cabin while still maintaining plenty of space for recreation and outdoor activities. The wooded setting offers the perfect balance of seclusion and convenience, making it an ideal location for a year-round residence, seasonal retreat, or investment property. Electric and gas were previously utilized at the old sugar shack located on the property, offering added potential for future use.

If you've been searching for a peaceful piece of land with endless potential, this Wade Hill Road property is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Bring your vision and make this beautiful Ellington property your own. Approximately 3.7 one the L shape lot and 9.5 on the other side.
